search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail ModifyDBInstance 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "errorCode", "responseElements.pendingModifiedValues.masterUserPassword" as eventSource, eventName, errorCode, setPassword nodrop 
| where isBlank(errorCode) and eventSource="rds.amazonaws.com" and eventName="ModifyDBInstance" 
| if((!isBlank(setPassword)),1,0) as setPasswordEvent 
| sum(setPasswordEvent) as count 
| "RDS_ModifyingAdminPassword" as benchmarkname 
| "EventCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("RDS_ModifyingAdminPassword") in benchmarkname, values("EventCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
